fields.name: checkouteventtype
fields.label: Checkout Event Type
fields.description: Optional Launch event fired when order summary loads.

fields.name: back-path
fields.label: Back Path
fields.description: Where to navigate on BACK. Use a full AEM path (e.g. /content/<site-name>/language-masters/<language-node>/checkout).

fields.name: confirm-path
fields.label: Confirm Path
fields.description: Where to navigate on CONFIRM ORDER. Use a full AEM path (e.g. /content/<site-name>/language-masters/<language-node>/order-confirmation). Order number is appended as ?order=.

fields.name: custom-class
fields.label: Custom class
fields.description: Space-separated class names to add to the block

fields.name: mobileFormID
fields.label: Mobile Form ID
fields.description: Optional form ID to associate with this form in the mobile app.

fields.name: mobileRedirectUrl
fields.label: Mobile Redirect URL
fields.description: Page to open in the mobile app after confirming the order. Leave empty to keep the current mobile redirect default.
